'''Keff''' was an individual who served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Keff and a group of Security Force officers apprended a group of agents in a [[Docking bay 33|docking bay]] in [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Spaceport]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], whom they suspected of being [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Afterward, one of the officers ordered Keff to return to the Security Forces' headquarters.
